r.경제 체제: Market economy · clothing exports and remittances
r.주식시장 시가총액: $26.2 billion, 6% of GDP (2025, listed domestic companies)
r.Consumer price level: 29% of the US level (2025, World Bank, household consumption at purchasing power parity against the market exchange rate)
r.한국이 파는 것: Refined petroleum 46%, Plastics 6%, Machinery, computers 6%, Hot-rolled steel 4% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Clothing (woven) 50%, T-shirts 15%, Sweaters 14%, Other clothing (knit) 10% (2025, share of value)
r.여행경보: Parts of the country: Leave now · Rest of the country: Avoid travel
r.정치 구도: Student protests in 2024 toppled a long-ruling government, and after an interim government it held elections in 2026.

t.why: The world's second-largest clothing exporter, and one of the countries most vulnerable to rising seas and floods.
t.rel: Almost entirely surrounded by India, so rivers, borders and migration are always intertwined. It hosts around a million Rohingya refugees who fled Myanmar.
t.korea: Many Korean clothing and textile companies produce there.
t.know: Protests to defend the Bengali language in 1952 led UNESCO to make that day, February 21, International Mother Language Day.
t.etext: A country that makes clothing for the world, the second-largest clothing exporter after China. Remittances from workers abroad are large too. With exports concentrated in clothing, building other industries is the task.
